texts: 初次指點：師父把最基本的架勢再講一遍，弟子這次聽懂了。
定向之約：師父說：先把基礎拳練到不用想。阿木點頭記下。

cases.text: 歸來相談：這趟沒機會用上齊眉棍：兩人說好下次先在營地對練。
cases.note: the staff was equipped, yet the recorded hits were punches; the combat AI falls back to a punch whenever a sweep cannot start (cause per swing not recorded). The follow-up correctly reads it as not using the staff
